mr_description:
- DRY
- Simplify expression
- Use auto
- Join declaration and assignment
- C++ style cast instead of C
- Declaration hides previous
- Else after return
- Redundant c_str()
- Reserve vector size
- Don't use endl
- Narrowing conversion
- Calling static via instance
- App: Minor formatting from review

expected_issues.title: The lambda parameter `str` is unnecessarily defined as `std::string` when it could use st…
expected_issues.description: The lambda parameter `str` is unnecessarily defined as `std::string` when it could use string literals directly, creating redundant string conversions. While string concatenation requires one string type, the implementation should optimize for minimal object creation by using C-style strings where possible.
